content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Show cash, receivables, payables, DSO and DPO by company

content.statement:
WITH __wc AS (
  SELECT
    is_group_as_of,
    company AS wc_company,
    year_month AS wc_year_month,
    cash_inr,
    cogs_3m_inr,
    payables_inr,
    receivables_inr,
    revenue_3m_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_WORKING_CAPITAL
)
SELECT
  wc_company AS company,
  wc_year_month AS as_of_month,
  SUM(cash_inr) AS cash_inr,
  SUM(receivables_inr) AS receivables_inr,
  SUM(payables_inr) AS payables_inr,
  IFF(
    SUM(revenue_3m_inr) = 0 OR SUM(revenue_3m_inr) IS NULL,
    0,
    SUM(receivables_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_3m_inr), 0)
  ) * 91 AS dso_days,
  IFF(
    SUM(cogs_3m_inr) = 0 OR SUM(cogs_3m_inr) IS NULL,
    0,
    SUM(payables_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(cogs_3m_inr), 0)
  ) * 91 AS dpo_days
FROM __wc
WHERE
  is_group_as_of
GROUP BY
  wc_company,
  wc_year_month
ORDER BY
  receivables_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 0107264e-9303-454e-ae48-2267fd0ac8b4)
;
